title: 周六

series.next: The video is in every group chat in the district. 老周's phone won't stop ringing.

setting: 金桂苑's square, Saturday, 7 pm. The talent show.

wu.name: 吴阿姨
wu.en: 3号楼: knows someone who saw it

steps.narr: Saturday night. You're in the suit. It's slightly too big.

else.narr: Saturday night. 婷婷 is in the dress. You're in the wings, holding the speaker.

steps.narr: The square. Two hundred neighbours on folding stools. One stage light.

steps.zh: 我早说了，这事儿不简单。
steps.en: I said all along there was more to this.

say.en: Ask the crowd: does anyone have a speaker?
answers: 谁有音箱？借我们用一下！
say.gloss: Does anyone have a speaker? Lend it to us!
say.tip: 音箱 yīnxiāng = a (loud)speaker. 借……用一下 = borrow ... for a moment.

ok.narr: Silence. Then a phone torch. Then twenty. Nobody has a speaker.

answers: 各位邻居，谁家有音箱，借来救个急！
各位邻居，谁家有音箱？救个急！
4.gloss: Neighbours! Whose home has a speaker? Help us out!
4.tip: 救个急 jiù ge jí = help out in a pinch.

say.en: Improvise: no music? Then we sing it ourselves.
answers: 我们自己唱吧！大家一起！
say.gloss: No music? Then let's sing it ourselves!
say.tip: 自己 zìjǐ = ourselves: 我们自己唱.

ok.narr: 老周 hums the first bar. Alone. It is very quiet.

answers: 没音乐不要紧，我们自己唱！
没有音乐不要紧，我们自己唱！
4.gloss: No music? Doesn't matter. We'll sing it ourselves!
4.tip: 不要紧 bú yàojǐn = it doesn't matter.

steps.narr: Then, from the front row: 胡阿姨.
The three aunties are humming the waltz. Then the whole square is.

say.en: Take the mic and announce the dance.
answers: 下面请欣赏，老周的华尔兹！
say.tip: 下面请欣赏…… = and now, please enjoy ...: every Chinese stage, ever.

ok.narr: They dance. Two hundred neighbours hum. Nobody misses the speaker.

answers: 下面有请老周，带来华尔兹！
下面有请老周，为大家带来华尔兹！
4.gloss: And now, 老周, with the waltz!
4.tip: 有请 yǒu qǐng = please welcome.

say.en: Lead the clapping, or hand the mic to 赵奶奶.

ok.narr: Two hundred pairs of hands, on the beat. Mostly.

alts.en: Or: hand the mic to 赵奶奶

then.narr: 赵奶奶 sings the next verse. Sixty seconds exactly.

answers: 掌声在哪里？大家一起拍手！
大家跟着节奏，一起拍手！
4.gloss: Let's hear it! Everyone, clap along!

answers: 赵奶奶，这一段非您莫属！
这一段非您莫属，赵奶奶请！
alts.gloss: 赵奶奶, this verse could only be yours!

steps.en: The video is online before the last note: two hundred people clapping, slightly off the beat. 📱

else.en: 赵奶奶's verse goes round every group chat in the district. Sixty seconds exactly. 📱
